question:
Choose the correct phrase for the word highlighted in bold.

Let's try to **think outside the box** and come up with a new solution to this problem.

options.text: To consider unconventional and creative solutions.
To reject all solutions without analysis.
To solve problems using only existing rules.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To consider unconventional and creative solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"think outside the box"** means to approach problems or tasks in a creative and non-traditional way. (बॉक्स से बाहर सोचने का मतलब रचनात्मक और पारंपरिक रूप से अलग तरीके से समस्याओं या कार्यों का समाधान करना है।)

 
 
• **Example:** Instead of using the same marketing strategies, the team decided to think outside the box and created a viral social media campaign.
 
 
 
• **"Unconventional"** refers to not following the usual or traditional way of doing something, often leading to innovative solutions. (अपरंपरागत का मतलब है कि किसी काम को सामान्य या पारंपरिक तरीके से नहीं करना।)
 
 
• **Example:** Her unconventional teaching methods helped students understand complex topics in a fun and engaging way.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase "think outside the box" encourages creativity and innovation, making **Option 1** the correct choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2:** To reject all solutions without analysis (विश्लेषण के बिना सभी समाधानों को अस्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example:** Rejecting all proposals without analyzing them is not a constructive approach to problem-solving.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** To solve problems using only existing rules (सिर्फ मौजूदा नियमों का उपयोग करके समस्याओं को हल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Following only the existing rules limited their ability to find a unique solution to the issue.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** To follow traditional methods strictly (पारंपरिक तरीकों का सख्ती से पालन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He insisted on strictly following traditional methods even when modern alternatives were available.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
